description: Modify wall thermal attributes. This is a synonym for wall thermal attribute (please refer to this command for details).

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.wall.thermal.find(id).set_temp() - same object setters as wall thermal attribute

examples.description: Initialize the temperature of all thermal walls

notes: The facet keyword requires an explicit range; without one the command is rejected ('No range is given with the facet keyword') on all of 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): accepted at wall level and, with a range, at facet level on all six consoles.
